acceptance.assertion: Verify the complete approved sanitized context published by the separately approved documentation administrative owner. acceptance.command:
set -eu
: "${PM_CONTEXT_INPUT:?actual native input directory required}"
: "${PM_CONTEXT_IMPORT_SHA256:?trusted approved outer manifest SHA-256 required}"
python3 - <<'VERIFY'
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import hashlib, json, os, re

digest = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
handoff = Path(os.environ['PM_CONTEXT_INPUT']).resolve(strict=True)
outer_path = handoff / 'context-import-manifest.json'
trusted = os.environ['PM_CONTEXT_IMPORT_SHA256']
assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', trusted)
assert outer_path.is_file() and not outer_path.is_symlink()
assert digest(outer_path) == trusted, 'untrusted outer manifest'
outer = json.loads(outer_path.read_text())
prefix = 'docs/architecture/pm-server/'
assert outer['target_prefix'] == prefix
rows = outer['files']
assert rows, 'empty import manifest'
repo = Path.cwd().resolve(strict=True)
root = repo / prefix
assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
for parent in (repo / 'docs', repo / 'docs/architecture'):
    assert not parent.is_symlink(), 'symlinked context parent'
expected = set()
for row in rows:
    target = row['target']
    rel = PurePosixPath(target)
    assert not rel.is_absolute() and '..' not in rel.parts
    assert str(rel) == target and target.startswith(prefix)
    assert target not in expected, 'duplicate target'
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', row['sha256'])
    expected.add(target)
    path = repo.joinpath(*rel.parts)
    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), target
    path.resolve(strict=True).relative_to(root.resolve(strict=True))
    assert digest(path) == row['sha256'], target
nodes = list(root.rglob('*'))
assert not any(path.is_symlink() for path in nodes)
actual = {path.relative_to(repo).as_posix()
          for path in nodes if path.is_file()}
assert actual == expected, 'missing or extra imported files'
inner_target = prefix + 'IMPORT-MANIFEST.json'
assert inner_target in expected, 'inner manifest is not authenticated'
inner = json.loads((repo / inner_target).read_text())
assert inner['target_prefix'] == prefix
assert inner['files'] == [row for row in rows
                          if row['target'] != inner_target]
print('All approved context paths, payload digests and manifest bindings match')
VERIFY
git diff --check
